title: Mushroom Sorceress with Target
description: A female figure in ornate horned armor and patterned suit stands centered in front of a large red-and-white bullseye target. She is surrounded by a giant green-and-pink mushroom, smaller mushrooms growing from sandy ground, and floating circular portraits connected by glowing lines against a dark background with a distant castle.
prompt: A female sorceress wearing a horned helmet and colorful patterned armor stands in front of a giant red bullseye target. She is surrounded by a massive green mushroom with pink spots and smaller brown mushrooms growing from sandy dunes. Floating colorful circular medallions with classical profile portraits orbit around her, connected by glowing lines. Dark background with a distant castle on a hill, psychedelic surreal style.
